Honor your father and your mother, as the LORD your God has commanded you, so that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
Do not eat it, so that it may go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is right in the eyes of the LORD.

verses.text: Then Moses set aside three cities across the Jordan to the east

xrefs.text: Six of the cities you give the Levites are to be appointed as cities of refuge, to which a manslayer may flee. In addition to these, give the Levites forty-two other cities.
Select three cities across the Jordan and three in the land of Canaan as cities of refuge.
“Tell the Israelites to designate the cities of refuge, as I instructed you through Moses,

verses.text: to which a manslayer could flee after killing his neighbor unintentionally without prior malice. To save one’s own life, he could flee to one of these cities:

xrefs.text: designate cities to serve as your cities of refuge, so that a person who kills someone unintentionally may flee there.
Thus by two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled to take hold of the hope set before us may be strongly encouraged.
Six of the cities you give the Levites are to be appointed as cities of refuge, to which a manslayer may flee. In addition to these, give the Levites forty-two other cities.
These six cities will serve as a refuge for the Israelites and for the foreigner or stranger among them, so that anyone who kills a person unintentionally may flee there.
When the LORD your God has cut off the nations whose land He is giving you, and when you have driven them out and settled in their cities and houses,

verses.text: Bezer in the wilderness on the plateau belonging to the Reubenites, Ramoth in Gilead belonging to the Gadites, or Golan in Bashan belonging to the Manassites.

xrefs.text: And beyond the Jordan, east of Jericho, they designated Bezer on the wilderness plateau from the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead from the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan from the tribe of Manasseh.
Ben-geber in Ramoth-gilead (the villages of Jair son of Manasseh in Gilead belonged to him, as well as the region of Argob in Bashan with its sixty great cities with walls and bronze bars);
The Gershomites received the following: From the clan of the half-tribe of Manasseh they were given Golan in Bashan and also Ashtaroth, together with their pasturelands.
And from the tribe of Gad they were given Ramoth in Gilead, a city of refuge for the manslayer, Mahanaim,

This is what the Levite clans of the Gershonites were given: From the half-tribe of Manasseh they were given Golan in Bashan, a city of refuge for the manslayer, and Beeshterah— two cities, together with their pasturelands.

verses.text: This is the law that Moses set before the Israelites.

xrefs.text: ‘Cursed is he who does not put the words of this law into practice.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

Write on them all the words of this law when you have crossed over to enter the land that the LORD your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised you.
And you shall write distinctly upon these stones all the words of this law.”
When he is seated on his royal throne, he must write for himself a copy of this instruction on a scroll in the presence of the Levitical priests.
These are the commandments that the LORD gave to Moses for the Israelites on Mount Sinai.

verses.text: These are the testimonies, statutes, and ordinances that Moses proclaimed to them after they had come out of Egypt,

xrefs.text: I rejoice in the way of Your testimonies as much as in all riches.
Remove my scorn and contempt, for I have kept Your testimonies.

And keep the charge of the LORD your God to walk in His ways and to keep His statutes, commandments, ordinances, and decrees, as written in the Law of Moses, so that you may prosper in all you do and wherever you turn,
Your testimonies are indeed my delight; they are my counselors.
Blessed are those who keep His testimonies and seek Him with all their heart.

verses.text: while they were in the valley across the Jordan facing Beth-peor in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon and was defeated by Moses and the Israelites after they had come out of Egypt.

xrefs.text: So we stayed in the valley opposite Beth-peor.
They took possession of the land belonging to Sihon and to Og king of Bashan— the two Amorite kings across the Jordan to the east —
Yet we will not have an inheritance with them across the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on the east side of the Jordan.”
But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass through, for the LORD your God had made his spirit stubborn and his heart obstinate, that He might deliver him into your hand, as is the case this day.
At that time we took from the two kings of the Amorites the land across the Jordan, from the Arnon Valley as far as Mount Hermon—

verses.text: They took possession of the land belonging to Sihon and to Og king of Bashan— the two Amorite kings across the Jordan to the east —

xrefs.text: Then they turned and went up the road to Bashan, and Og king of Bashan and his whole army came out to meet them in battle at Edrei.
Then we turned and went up the road to Bashan, and Og king of Bashan and his whole army came out to meet us in battle at Edrei.
When you reached this place, Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan came out against us in battle, but we defeated them.

verses.text: extending from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley as far as Mount Siyon (that is, Hermon),

xrefs.text: which the Sidonians call Sirion but the Amorites call Senir—
From Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley, along with the city in the valley, even as far as Gilead, not one city had walls too high for us. The LORD our God gave us all of them.
So at that time we took possession of this land. To the Reubenites and Gadites I gave the land beyond Aroer along the Arnon Valley, and half the hill country of Gilead, along with its cities.
It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion. For there the LORD has bestowed the blessing of life forevermore.
This is what Moses had given to the clans of the tribe of Gad:

verses.text: including all the Arabah on the east side of the Jordan and as far as the Sea of the Arabah, below the slopes of Pisgah.

xrefs.text: The Jordan River in the Arabah bordered it from Chinnereth to the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea with the slopes of Pisgah to the east.
Beth-peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth—
